notes: The engine reads each name's own completed daily bars (about two years) and the weekly context; nothing is fetched for it.
A stance is the engine's net of its evidence kinds, a description of what the chart shows, never an instruction to buy or sell.
The desk's own pre-registered studies found no proven edge in chart patterns or candlesticks after costs; they are shown as a technician's read.
